scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @suq-insights/design-tokens && npm run build --workspace @suq-insights/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @suq-insights/api-client
scripts.check: npm run generate:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy && COVERAGE_FILE=/tmp/suq-api.coverage uv run pytest --cov=suq_api --cov-report=json:/tmp/suq-coverage.json --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=85 && uv run pip-audit
scripts.generate: npm run generate:tokens && npm run generate:openapi && npm run generate:api-client
scripts.generate:check: npm run check:generated --workspace @suq-insights/design-tokens && npm run check:generated --workspace @suq-insights/api-client
scripts.generate:openapi: cd apps/api && uv run python -m suq_api.openapi
scripts.lint: npm run lint:docs && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
